mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_sessions (id, user_id, book_id, title, level, forked_from, forked_at_seq, summary, summary_upto, summary_prompt_version, created_at, last_active_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{title}, #{level}, #{forkedFrom}, #{forkedAtSeq}, #{summary}, #{summaryUpto}, #{summaryPromptVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{lastActiveAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM chat_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY last_active_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET last_active_at = #{lastActiveAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_sessions SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
